followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: This is a neutral conversational follow-up best handled by the same model for continuity. Willet-235B leads across all internal evals and public benchmarks (e.g., Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3), and it treats neutral transactional requests as a baseline-comfortable task family, making it the stronger default for a straightforward query like this. Lapwing's only edge is on well-specified extraction tasks, which this isn't.
